description: This file defines the AuditResult class in the Drupal migrate module, encapsulating the outcome of a migration audit including status, reasons, and related methods.

classes.name: AuditResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a migration audit, including status, reasons, and utility methods for creating pass/fail results.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AuditResult with a migration, status, and optional reasons.

methods.name: getMigration
methods.description: Returns the migration associated with this audit result.

methods.name: passed
methods.description: Returns whether the migration passed the audit.

methods.name: addReason
methods.description: Adds a reason for the audit result.

methods.name: pass
methods.description: Creates a passing AuditResult for a migration.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Creates a failing AuditResult for a migration.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of reasons for the audit result.
